facts.text: John recently finished an amazing fantasy series that features wild twists and well-developed storylines and characters.

evidence.quote: I just finished this amazing fantasy series. It was a wild ride with so many twists. The author is amazing at creating awesome storylines and characters - I love getting lost in those fantasy worlds.

facts.text: Tim agrees with John's experience of being lost in a fantasy world and sees it as an escape.

evidence.quote: There's something special about being lost in an awesome fantasy realm and seeing what happens. It's like an escape.

facts.text: Tim mentions that 'That' is one of his favorite fantasy shows and suggests that John may have seen it.

evidence.quote: "That" is one of my favorite fantasy shows. Have you seen it?

facts.text: John confirms that he has seen 'That' and finds it amazing to see the worlds and characters come alive.

evidence.quote: Yeah, I saw "That"! It's amazing to see those worlds and characters come alive. It's a great way to escape reality!
